subject: Learning Methods
title: Metacognitive Knowledge
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Metacognitive Knowledge.

hook.text: She knew flashcards worked for vocabulary but failed for essays. That awareness itself was a skill.

buildup.text: Metacognitive knowledge covers three areas: yourself as a learner, the task demands, and strategy options.

discovery.text: Knowing you learn best visually is person knowledge. Knowing an exam is cumulative is task knowledge.

twist.text: Most students have strategy knowledge but lack person knowledge. They don't know their own weak spots.

climax.text: After every study session, note what worked, what didn't, and why. Build your learner profile over time.

punchline.text: Know your strategies. Know yourself better.

quiz.question: What are the three areas of metacognitive knowledge?
options: Person knowledge, task knowledge, and strategy knowledge
